verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports automation workflows triggered by schedules/webhooks across GitHub, Slack, Jira, Linear, plus API/CLI scripting, which could be used to fan out tasks across many items, but there is no explicit evidence of a bulk/batch operation feature (e.g., processing a list of items in one command or parallelized multi-item runs). missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation feature, evidence of parallel multi-item processing, documentation of a batch API or CLI flag for operating across many items at once.
